words.sense: Grounded in observed or measured evidence, including controlled or systematic investigation.
misconceptions: Any personal anecdote counts as empirical research.

words.sense: Learned or understood through direct personal participation and lived experience.
misconceptions: Firsthand learning must involve controlled measurements.

semantic_axes.description: Systematically observed results compared with personal experience.
Planned recordkeeping versus learning by taking part.

edges.boundary_rule: Empirical claims are grounded in systematically observed evidence; experiential insights arise primarily from firsthand lived experience.
clues_a: counts observations according to a consistent method
tests a claim against recorded results
clues_b: learns by personally doing a task
reflects on what participation felt like

misconceptions.M1: Any personal anecdote counts as empirical research.
misconceptions.M2: Firsthand learning must involve controlled measurements.
misconceptions.M3: Scientific-looking language alone establishes the source of knowledge.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Anika’s evidence about commute times?

beats.text: Anika recorded how long the bus took every morning for sixty school days.
beats.decisive_clue: sixty days of recorded travel times
beats.reason: She bases her conclusion on systematically logged observations.

beats.text: She compared the recorded times before and after a timetable change.
beats.decisive_clue: comparison of times across two defined periods
beats.reason: The before-and-after comparison strengthens the measured basis of the claim.

chains.feedback_short: The before-and-after comparison strengthens the measured basis of the claim.
chains.feedback_deep: She bases her conclusion on systematically logged observations. The before-and-after comparison strengthens the measured basis of the claim. Empirical checks what happens; experiential learns what it feels like.
chains.contrast_rule: Empirical checks what happens; experiential learns what it feels like.

hints.attention: Look at how the evidence was collected.
hints.axis: Systematically observed results compared with personal experience.
hints.contrast: Empirical checks what happens; experiential learns what it feels like.
